description: Type createLoadBalancer's Primary IP quota failure. A Load Balancer takes two of the project's public IPv4 addresses, so an exhausted quota fails the create with Forbidden (403 resource_limit_exceeded, message 'Primary IP limit exceeded'), the same error createPrimaryIp types as PrimaryIpLimitExceeded.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The project has no remaining Primary IP quota for the Load Balancer's public IPs (Hetzner `resource_limit_exceeded`, HTTP 403). Servers and Load Balancers share it; it frees up as they are deleted.
